scholar_citations.work: Pico della Mirandola's Encounter with Jewish Mysticism
scholar_citations.quotation: In Kabbalistic mysticism, magic and theurgy are inseparable: both involve manipulation of divine names and sefirot through precise knowledge and intention.

scholar_citations.work: Magic and the Dignity of Man: Pico della Mirandola and His Oration in Modern Memory
scholar_citations.quotation: Pico's defense of magic in the Oration is inseparable from his Kabbalism: both are disciplines of transformation and divine connection.
